tools.name: ipdetective_account_usage
tools.description: Read account request and lookup limits and current usage. Does not look up an IP address.

tools.name: ipdetective_lookup_ip
tools.description: Look up a public IPv4 or IPv6 address for IPDetective's bot signal and optional datacenter, VPN/proxy, ASN and country information. Uses your vendor allowance. This is a risk signal, not proof of abuse. No automatic retries.

tools.name: ipdetective_lookup_batch
tools.description: Look up 1–100 public IP addresses in one vendor request. Requires confirm:true because it consumes your IPDetective allowance. Duplicates are removed before submission. No automatic retries or background polling; check usage before resubmitting after an error.
